requirements.Title: AI Productivity Solutions
requirements.Description: Integrate advanced AI-based productivity features, including Perfect Print and Perfect Scan, to enhance workflow and manageability for SMB users.
requirements.Rationale: SMBs require efficient and easy-to-use solutions due to limited IT resources; AI solutions will streamline tasks and reduce manual intervention.
requirements.Dependencies: AI technology stack, software integration with printer firmware and SMB portal
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: AI-based print and scan features are accessible through the printer UI and SMB portal; user testing confirms workflow improvements; meets specified accuracy and speed benchmarks.

requirements.Title: Lowest Business Total Cost of Ownership (TCO)
requirements.Description: Design the printer to achieve HP’s lowest business TCO for SMBs, with minimal intervention and consumables cost.
requirements.Rationale: Cost efficiency is a top priority for SMBs; lower TCO is a key competitive differentiator.
requirements.Dependencies: Consumables design, energy efficiency, sustainability features
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: TCO analysis demonstrates lowest cost in class compared to competitors; validated by internal cost modeling and external benchmarking.

requirements.Title: Customer Replaceable Maintenance Box
requirements.Description: Implement a user-replaceable maintenance box to minimize service calls and printer downtime for SMBs.
requirements.Rationale: SMBs lack dedicated IT support; easy maintenance is critical for operational continuity.
requirements.Stakeholders: Quality, R&D Telemetry, Supplies Quality, DVAR, Prod Steward
requirements.Dependencies: Maintenance box design, service documentation, user instructions
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Maintenance box can be replaced by non-technical users in under 5 minutes without tools; validated in usability studies.

requirements.Title: SMB Device Management Portal
requirements.Description: Develop a consolidated web-based portal for SMB customers to manage multiple HP printers, monitor usage, and access support.
requirements.Rationale: Target SMB customers have multiple devices and limited IT staff; centralized management increases efficiency and reduces support burden.
requirements.Dependencies: Portal software development, telemetry integration, user authentication
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Portal supports registration and management of 6-15 printers per account; allows monitoring, configuration, and support access; positive feedback in user testing.

requirements.Title: Sustainability – 60% Recycled Content Plastic (RCP)
requirements.Description: Ensure the printer is built with at least 60% recycled content plastic, surpassing competitors’ sustainability benchmarks.
requirements.Rationale: Sustainability is a top customer priority and competitive differentiator; aligns with HP’s environmental goals.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Bill of materials and supplier documentation confirm 60% RCP; validated in third-party audits.

requirements.Title: Keyed Ink Bottles for Refilling
requirements.Description: Use keyed ink bottles to prevent incorrect refilling and ensure user safety and printer reliability.
requirements.Rationale: Prevents user error, reduces service calls, and protects printer warranty.
requirements.Dependencies: Ink bottle design, printer hardware compatibility
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Keyed bottles only fit correct tanks; field testing shows zero misfills in test group.

requirements.Title: Warranty: 80,000 pages or 2 Years
requirements.Description: Offer a warranty covering either 80,000 pages or 2 years, whichever comes first.
requirements.Rationale: Addresses SMBs’ need for reliability and cost predictability; reduces perceived risk of ownership.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Warranty terms published; printer passes reliability tests for 80,000 pages or 2 years of typical SMB use.

requirements.Title: PHA and MINK Serviceability
requirements.Description: Enable customer replaceable (PHA) and service center replaceable (MINK) parts, targeting maximum customer replaceability for out-of-warranty repairs.
requirements.Rationale: Reduces downtime and service costs for SMBs without IT staff; enhances customer satisfaction.
requirements.Stakeholders: Quality, DVAR, Supplies Quality, Prod Steward
requirements.Dependencies: Parts design, service documentation, training materials
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: At least 80% of common service parts are customer replaceable; validated by service call data post-launch.

requirements.Title: Support for PDL/PS and Improved Print Speeds
requirements.Description: Ensure the printer supports PDL/PS (Page Description Language/PostScript) and achieves improved print speeds (target: 25/20 ppm for PDL SKUs).
requirements.Rationale: Essential for business environments with diverse document workflows and higher productivity demands.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Printer achieves target speeds in independent testing; PDL/PS compatibility verified with standard business workflows.

requirements.Title: Blue Angel Certification
requirements.Description: Achieve Blue Angel environmental certification for PDL SKUs.
requirements.Rationale: Environmental certifications are increasingly required for business and public sector customers.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Certification awarded by Blue Angel authority for at least one PDL SKU.

requirements.Title: Mobile Printing Support via HP App
requirements.Description: Enable mobile printing capabilities through the HP App for seamless printing from smartphones and tablets.
requirements.Rationale: Mobile device usage is growing in SMBs; mobile printing is a critical workflow feature.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Mobile print jobs can be submitted and completed from the HP App on iOS and Android; validated by user testing.

requirements.Title: Platform Support for PaaS (Printing as a Service)
requirements.Description: Printer and portal must support HP’s Printing as a Service (PaaS) business model for SMBs.
requirements.Rationale: Enables recurring revenue and aligns with HP’s strategic shift to service-based offerings.
requirements.Dependencies: Portal and device integration, subscription management
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: SMBs can enroll in and manage PaaS subscriptions through the portal; billing and usage tracked accurately.
